title: Layer gates are well formed
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. For every layer $m$ below the depth of $F$ and every node $u$ in the successor of that layer, the associated gate has pairwise distinct argument vertices, and if its kind is NOT then it has exactly one argument.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
$u$ is a node in the successor of layer $m$
